You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies an abstract termination-detection problem for a ring with synchronous communication. It models a set of nodes indexed by Node, where each node may be active or inactive, and a boolean flag records whether global termination has been detected. The actions allow active nodes to terminate, active nodes to wake up other nodes, and a separate detection step to set the detection flag when all nodes are inactive; the specification also states a fairness condition on the detection action and defines correctness, quiescence, and liveness-style temporal properties.
